main_text.p: & facra passim Scriptura nobis testa-tur: & etiam experientia, recte rem consideremus, verū esse demonstrat. Abrahamo namq; & Lotho legimus angelos ante Sodomæ & reliquarū circumiacentiū urbium euersionem apparuisse: ut est in Genesi cap 28 & 29. Et habemus inter cætera illustre sanè pulcherrimumq; huius rei testi-monium Exodi 4. ubi angelus Do-mini eo ipso tempore, quo populum Iudaicū hostiliter persequebatur Pha-rao, castra Israelitica conspectus est præire. Iosuæ consimili ratione, cum prelium contra hostes ingrederetur, angelus in albēti præcesit equo: qui pro populo Dei strenuè pugnare ui-sus est. Ita & in Nouo testamento le-gitur, Iosepho apparuisse in somnis angelum: qui monebat eum, ne Ma-riam grauidam Spiritus sancti virtu-te facta deserteret. Et cum Herodes, crudelis ille tyrannus, pueri I E S V uitæ insidiaretur: angeli solùm com-monefactione ab imminēte periculo

page.notes: Printed text is a single column; the catchword "Ioseph" is set at the right below the last line. Right margin shows only cropped show-through from the facing page, not transcribed. Some words near the top (e.g. "recte", "demonstrat") are partly obscured by a stain and read with reasonable confidence; "albēti" and "Nouo" are as printed.
